props.description: The renderer's non-data config props (§1 "Non-data config props").

data.description: How to produce the renderer's DATA props.

mode.description: Which `DataSource` the bootstrap builds for `data` resolution. Optional — omitted (or "local") means the self-contained LOCAL store; kept optional so it stays in lockstep with the Python `PlotSpec` default (`mode="local"`).

endpoint.description: ENDPOINT only: absolute base URL of the repo server (no trailing slash), used to build `${endpoint}/api/artifacts/${hash}`.

DataSpec.description:
How the renderer's DATA props are produced.

 - `inline`: the data-contract props are plain JSON, carried directly in the    descriptor (2D contracts — Series[]/points[]/matrix/counts+edges/table/    figure). The bootstrap merges `props` straight onto the renderer. No    `DataSource` needed.  - `image`: a content-addressed image artifact (+ optional baseline +    overlay metadata). Resolved via `resolveImageViewportItems` against the    active `DataSource` (LOCAL `data:` URL or ENDPOINT `/api/artifacts/…`),    yielding `{ imageUrl, baselineUrl, overlay }` for `ImagePane`.
